build_audio_finetuning_task: build an AudioFinetuningTask to fine-tune an audio pretraining model with text labels and WER evaluation
create_label_encoder: create a LabelEncoder that encodes text labels into token IDs using a fairseq Dictionary
load_audio_dataset_with_labels: load an audio dataset split with compressed text labels and add targets for supervised training
evaluate_wer_with_inference: evaluate word error rate during validation by running beam search inference and comparing hypotheses to references
evaluate_bleu_with_inference: evaluate BLEU score during validation by running beam search inference and comparing tokenized hypotheses to references
